title: Event-log rotate and rechain follow symlinked log directories
description: packages/storage/src/event-log.ts derives archive and live paths from this.path and dirname(this.path), then rotate/rechain writes archives and the live log without proving the log directory realpath remains inside the workspace. storage rotate-log and doctor repair expose those maintenance paths for context.paths.eventLogFile, so a symlinked .boreal/log can redirect writes outside the project.
acceptanceCriteria: Event-log rotate and rechain reject symlinked log directories or any live/archive path whose real path escapes the configured workspace/runtime boundary.
Doctor repair and storage rotate-log surface a structured boundary diagnostic instead of writing through the escape.
Regression tests prove rotate and rechain on a symlinked .boreal/log cannot create or rewrite outside files.
